result.description: A fictional compact document scanner designed for archivists and field researchers who need quick, battery-powered digitization away from a desk. The Arcus 2400 supports USB-C power, Wi‑Fi transfer, duplex scanning, and onboard OCR workflow presets for receipts, notes, and folded maps. Its lightweight chassis and retractable feed tray make it suitable for mobile indexing, not high-volume office use.
